lines.text:
Even if Pokémon are the same level, that doesn’t
mean one is always as strong as another.\c
But a weak Pokémon can get stronger the
more Candies you give them...or so I hear.
When my Pokémon was poisoned the other day,\nit healed its own poisoning so I wouldn’t worry!\c\nIt must love me lots, don’t you think?

It’s true that higher-level Pokémon are stronger...\c
But all Pokémon have weaknesses, too, based on
their types.\c
Basically, you’re gonna have a hard time finding
one all-powerful Pokémon.
There’s a magazine called Pokémon Journal:\nThe Foodie Edition.

“The latest taste sensation that everyone is
talking about... That’s right!
It’s Pewter City’s Pewter Crunchies!\c
“They’re rugged and bumpy and brown, and
honestly, they look just like a bunch of rocks...\c
“But what really matters is the taste!
So dig right in and—
Argh! I-it’s so hard...\c
“Hard to stop eating after just one, I mean!
Yes, these snacks are as hard as that Geodude
used by Brock of the Pewter City Gym!\c
“Phew... They’re so deliciously dense that my
jaw is feeling pretty tired from all this chewing.\c
“But back to the taste... They’ve got a nice hint
of soy sauce flavoring, and they’re fantastic!”
